note: One baked take in FBX/GLB (master timeline). Unity: split into clips by these frame ranges; loop=true clips are seamless.

clips.name: Idle
clips.desc: cold: iris closed (-12 deg), turbine stopped

clips.name: Ignition
clips.desc: ignition: iris snaps open, turbine spools up, chamber glow, flame lights (flicker)

clips.name: ThrustLoop
clips.desc: sustained thrust: turbine 3 blades / 12 f (11-fold, seamless), flame pulses, iris open

clips.name: SpoolDown
clips.desc: cut-off: flame out, glow fades, iris closes, turbine runs down (ends 3 blades on)

gameplay: Animation is visual only: it adds no gameplay capability, shot count or timing authority.
